title: Vector handles
description: Two generous control points reshape a cubic path without hiding its construction.
useCase: Path shaping, motion trajectory editing, and teaching tangent relationships.
interaction: Drag a handle or move it with arrow keys
reducedMotion: Input follows immediately; press decoration has no transition.
limitations: Single cubic segment with fixed endpoints, not a complete path editor or easing-time solver.
look: Pale grey page with a white dotted-grid card holding a dark green cubic curve, square endpoints, ring handles on dashed tangents and monospace coordinates.
motion: Dragging either ring handle reshapes the cubic path and dashed tangents live, the handle dot scaling 1.15× while pressed; arrow keys nudge it 2 units, or 10 with Shift.
adapt: `points` holds the two control points in a 0–100 `viewBox`, clamped by `update` and written into the cubic `d` string; endpoints stay fixed at `M10 75` and `90 25`. Wire `points` to your easing or path data, keeping pointer capture and arrow-key handling.
